name: Hiint – Dynamic Personalization for Woocommerce
author: HIINT

sections.description:
With Hiint, you can show the right message to the right user at the right time to significantly boost your Average Order Value (AOV) and conversion rate.

Personalization is the future of e-commerce. Today’s users expect tailored experiences that guide them seamlessly through your site. Hiint makes adding personalized, dynamic content effortless, enabling you to:

  • Increase customer engagement
  • Help with purchasing decisions
  • Provide relevant, targeted messaging

Dynamic Features
Hiint lets you effortlessly add and manage the following features:

  • Product Recommendations: Suggest products based on user behavior, cart, current URL and more.
  • Notices & Banners: Add store, product, category and checkout notices.
  • Top Bar Messaging: Display targeted messages across your store.
  • Product Badges: Highlight products with relevant badges

Rule Engine
Choose when and where to show your personalized content using our intuitive Rule Engine. Set rules based on:

  • Current User Data: Logged in/not logged in, has purchased/has not purchased
  • URL Data: Show content when the Url contains/does not contain data. Perfect for UTM parameters – show content when a user visits from a specific marketing channel.
  • Product Data: Stock level, tags, categories, price, newer-than/older-than, on-sale and more.
  • Cart Data: Items in the cart, total value, cart-contains-tag, cart-contains-category and more.

Use Cases
Here are some practical examples of how Hiint can transform your WooCommerce store:

  • Show informational banners on specific product pages to explain offers, shipping policies, or usage guides.
  • Highlight related / accompanying product on product page.
  • Recommend products at checkout based on what’s currently in the user’s cart
  • Show discount code in the top bar when a user comes from a specific email campaign
  • Category-specific notices and offers
  • Display top-bar messages offering discounts to visitors who have not yet made a purchase
  • Add “Limited Stock” badges to create urgency and drive sales.

And many more.

Features

  • User-friendly interface for adding and managing personalized features. Live preview window with mobile view.
  • Flexible Rule Engine for targeting content.
  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce.
  • Lightweight and performance-focused.
  • Compatible with caching plugins
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Hiint settings to configure your personalized content and rules.
sections.faq:
Q: Does Hiint slow down my site?

A: No, Hiint is designed with performance in mind. It uses optimized processes to ensure your site remains fast.

Q: Do I need coding knowledge to use Hiint?

A: Not at all! Hiint is designed for all users, with an intuitive interface and no coding required.
